paragraphs: Buyers must verify project approvals, plot availability, payment instructions, recipient details, booking procedure, documentation, and receipt process before making any payment.

sections.heading: Inquiry and Communication
paragraphs: When you submit a property inquiry or message us through WhatsApp, you allow us to reply about that inquiry. You may request that we stop contacting you at any time.

sections.heading: No Misuse
paragraphs: You may not copy website content for deceptive marketing, submit false inquiries, misuse contact forms, or use this website in a way that harms the website or other visitors.

sections.heading: Changes to Terms
paragraphs: We may update these terms when needed. Continued use of the website after updates means you accept the revised terms.
To continue browsing, use the homepage, all pages directory, or buyer resources.
